# ECDC — Energy Conscious Design & Construction

> ECDC (Energy Conscious Design & Construction, Inc.) is an engineer-led design-build firm in Panama City, Florida, serving Bay County and the wider Florida Panhandle since 2003. A single licensed Professional Engineer (P.E.) who is also a licensed General Contractor designs, engineers, and builds every project — commercial buildings, custom homes, and hurricane-resistant, energy-conscious construction.

ECDC is unusual in the construction industry: the same firm that seals the engineering drawings also builds the project. Principal Dr. AbdelRaouf "Raouf" Arafa holds a Ph.D. in engineering, is a licensed Florida Professional Engineer (P.E. #PE51761), and a licensed General Contractor (CGC #CGC060863). This "engineer-builder" model means design intent, structural engineering, and construction all come from one accountable source, reducing handoffs, change orders, and surprises during inspection.

A full-content version of this file — with the complete text of every key page, plus the hurricane-construction FAQ and project case studies — is available at https://ecdc-us.com/llms-full.txt.

## Services

- **Design & Engineering** — Civil and site-plan design: parking and circulation layouts, utility routing, stormwater and drainage design, grading, structural engineering, and sealed, permit-ready drawing sets. Includes wind-load and continuous-load-path engineering for the Florida Panhandle.
- **Commercial Construction** — Ground-up fuel stations, restaurants, and retail; sitework, foundations, and canopy structures; tenant build-outs and commercial remodels; and post-storm commercial rebuilds. Past work includes projects for Chevron and Señor Frog's in Panama City Beach.
- **Custom Homes & Major Remodels** — Design-build custom homes engineered for the coast, including elevated and piling construction for flood and storm-surge zones, plus major renovations.
- **Energy-Conscious Systems** — Insulated Concrete Form (ICF) construction, passive solar orientation, high-performance insulation and glazing, geothermal readiness, and rainwater strategies that lower long-term operating costs.
- **Hurricane-Resistant Construction** — Wind-load engineering, ICF walls, impact-rated openings, and continuous roof-to-foundation load paths designed for Bay County's high-velocity wind zone.
- **Professional Training** — Short courses in green-building design and optimal energy systems for engineers, architects, and contractors.

## Service Area

Panama City, Panama City Beach, Lynn Haven, and all of Bay County, Florida, plus the wider Florida Panhandle.
